Your own stock photos: in the add / edit form, tap “Product photo” and pick the real photo from your phone — it uploads and becomes that product's shop photo for every visitor.
Your exact product in 3D / AR: a photo on its own is flat, so 3D / AR uses a model of the product type you choose in the form. For your actual product to stand in a customer's room, it first needs a 3D model file (.glb) — made either by scanning the real product from all sides (photogrammetry, about 30–40 photos) or by a 3D artist modelling it from measurements.
